comment: Shared digest-carry equivalence vectors: each case pins digest_state(seed, 64, u32::MAX, state) over a deterministically generated per-parameter state image (splitmix64-style LCG, parameter i seeded generator_seed + i + 1; value = (s >> 40) as f32 / 2^24, f32-le). A conforming streaming carry must reproduce every pinned digest bit-for-bit when fed one-shot, per fold window (per-parameter chunking at window_size — tails short, a parameter never spans a window), per byte, and at any unaligned stride. seed_fill is the 32-byte round-seed fill; block size is pinned at 64 (the production digest granularity).

cases.name: parameter tails: 24-byte windows straddle the 64-byte block framing
multi-chunk parameters at a block-aligned window
window size equals the digest block size
ceremony-shaped registration order, scaled (profile chunk 16, window 3 chunks)
partial final block: state is not a block multiple
